name: cutin_band
prompt:

Background solid vivid P5 red #E60012. On left black halftone dots densely packed at left edge and progressively sparse toward the right. Two or three sharp white hard-edged diagonal streaks. On right, a dramatic CLOSE-UP OF JOKER'S EYES and upper face, unmasked, face turned three-quarter toward screen right, sharp focused eyes looking right with highlights, black hair from reference, high-contrast face with hard black graphic shadows. Make the eye close-up dominate right portion, not a full bust portrait. Thin black rule along entire top edge and bottom edge. Crisp flat graphic P5 game UI, clean red/black/white palette, no text, no letters, no watermark, no soft glow. Exact panoramic layout 1600 pixels wide by 420 pixels tall.
